strings.zh: 喜一
strings.en: Billy
strings.notes: US 0683/0; 喜一 not in 0719; US contact Billy (US 0683)

strings.zh: 我的自由研究课题{NEWLINE}就是道馆馆主！{SCROLL}只要在道馆以外的地方跟他们聊天{NEWLINE}他们就会把电话号码{CLEAR}告诉给我们！{SCROLL}不过在这之前,{NEWLINE}我们交换一下电话号码吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: My independent research{NEWLINE}project is on Gym Leaders!{SCROLL}If you chat with them somewhere{NEWLINE}other than their Gym, they’ll{CLEAR}give you their phone numbers!{SCROLL}But before that, let’s{NEWLINE}trade phone numbers!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 等我知道了道馆馆主{NEWLINE}出行的地点后,{CLEAR}我会打电话通知你的！
strings.en: Once I find out where the Gym{NEWLINE}Leaders go when they’re out,{CLEAR}I’ll call and let you know!

strings.zh: 哎？你不想去{NEWLINE}了解一下道馆馆主吗？
strings.en: Huh? Don’t you want to know anything{NEWLINE}about Gym Leaders?

strings.zh: 你看,果然还是想知道{NEWLINE}关于馆主的情报吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I knew it. I knew you’d want to{NEWLINE}know about the Gym Leaders! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你已经就在附近了吧？{NEWLINE}那直接和我说话好了！
strings.en: Hey, you’re nearby, aren’t you?{NEWLINE}So we should talk face-to-face!

strings.zh: 小茜好像经常在{NEWLINE}满金市百货商店的{CLEAR}６楼休息！
strings.en: Whitney likes to relax on the{NEWLINE}sixth floor of the Goldenrod{CLEAR}Department Store.

strings.zh: 阿杏要{NEWLINE}给他爸爸送晚饭,{SCROLL}所以傍晚会去{NEWLINE}冠军之路的入口！
strings.en: Janine takes dinner to her dad,{SCROLL}so in the evening she goes to{NEWLINE}the entrance to Victory Road!

strings.zh: 阿速到了星期一{NEWLINE}会来彩虹市。
strings.en: Falkner likes to come to Celadon City on{NEWLINE}Mondays, it seems.

strings.zh: 小霞好像很喜欢{NEWLINE}２５号道路啊！{SCROLL}每天到了傍晚{NEWLINE}都会去那里看落日！
strings.en: It seems like Misty really likes Route{NEWLINE}25!{SCROLL}Every evening, she goes there to watch{NEWLINE}the sunset!
strings.notes: US 0683/9 | RV072: meaning: 傍晚 = evening (D-1917)

strings.zh: 听说娜姿在{NEWLINE}星期五的晚上{CLEAR}会出现在{CLEAR}浅葱市的港口上！{SCROLL}真是个神出鬼没的人啊！
strings.en: Sabrina likes to visit the port in Olivine{NEWLINE}on Friday nights.{SCROLL}She really shows up in the strangest{NEWLINE}places, doesn’t she!

strings.zh: 这个我只跟你说哦,{SCROLL}其实蜜柑看上去很一般,{NEWLINE}但食量却大得很哦！{SCROLL}差不多中午的时候{NEWLINE}去浅葱市的食堂{CLEAR}就能遇到蜜柑！
strings.en: I’m only telling you this...{SCROLL}Jasmine looks ordinary, but she{NEWLINE}actually eats a ton!{SCROLL}If you go to the Olivine Café around{NEWLINE}noon, you’ll run into Jasmine!
strings.notes: US 0683/11 | RV072: omission: restored 'looks ordinary'; around noon (D-1917)

strings.zh: 红莲道馆的馆主夏伯{NEWLINE}好像非常喜欢{CLEAR}红莲岛啊。{SCROLL}每周二的早上会在{NEWLINE}老红莲道馆所在的地方{CLEAR}独自一个人沉思。
strings.en: Cinnabar Gym’s Leader Blaine really{NEWLINE}seems to love Cinnabar Island.{SCROLL}Every Tuesday morning, he meditates{NEWLINE}alone on the site where the old Cinnabar{CLEAR}Gym stood.
strings.notes: US 0683/12 | RV072: meaning: loves the island; alone restored

strings.zh: 尼比市的馆主小刚{NEWLINE}非常喜欢岩石！{SCROLL}他每天到了中午{NEWLINE}都会去{CLEAR}地鼠洞穴里去。
strings.en: Pewter Gym’s Leader Brock really loves{NEWLINE}rocks!{SCROLL}Every day at noon, he goes into{NEWLINE}Diglett’s Cave.
strings.notes: US 0683/13; modernised from US 0683#13 | RV072: meaning: at noon (D-1917)

strings.zh: 阿笔在每周四{NEWLINE}都会去寻找虫精灵,{CLEAR}地点应该是关东的{CLEAR}常磐森林！
strings.en: Bugsy goes looking for Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon every Thursday. I think{CLEAR}it’s in Viridian Forest in Kanto!

strings.zh: 柳伯总给人一种{NEWLINE}成熟的感觉！{SCROLL}听说他会在早上７点左右{NEWLINE}会去眺望愤怒湖！
strings.en: Pryce always comes across as so{NEWLINE}mature!{SCROLL}I hear he gazes out at the Lake of Rage{NEWLINE}at around seven in the morning!
strings.notes: US 0683/15 | RV072: meaning: mature air; approximate time, hearsay (D-1917)

strings.zh: 小松经常会去{NEWLINE}铃塔。{SCROLL}正因为他能如此地{NEWLINE}热衷于某件事,{CLEAR}才能成为道馆馆主的吧！
strings.en: Morty often goes to the Bell Tower.{SCROLL}I guess being that passionate{NEWLINE}about something is exactly{CLEAR}what made him a Gym Leader!

strings.zh: 我又进行了一轮{NEWLINE}苛刻的训练。{CLEAR}我们再来比一场吧！{CLEAR}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: I’ve been through another{NEWLINE}round of tough training. Let’s{CLEAR}have another match! I’ll be{CLEAR}waiting at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 你在干嘛？{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}{CLEAR}等你来对战！{CLEAR}快点过来。
strings.en: What are you doing? I’m waiting for{NEWLINE}our battle at {VAR:0104:3}!{CLEAR}Hurry up and get over here.

strings.zh: 等我了解了道馆馆主的情况后{NEWLINE}会打电话联系你的！
strings.en: Once I find out more about the Gym{NEWLINE}Leaders, I’ll call you!
strings.notes: US 0683/19 | RV072: meaning: call once he learns more (D-1917)
